tools.name: academy_runtime_inspect
tools.title: MCP release·업무·원천 계약
tools.description: This server; no student rows. view: 'identity' = release 세대, pointer, 브리지 해시, surfaceSha256; no other argument. 'capabilities' = work it knows (이 MCP로 할 수 있는 일), no LMS request: capabilityView 'hierarchy' (default), 'operations' (offset, limit), 'source_contract' with operationId, or 'workflow_rules'; workflow, domain filter. 'source_contracts' = one LMS page's static program, not run: kind 'printed_code' (출력코드 변환기), 'daily_test_catalog', 'middle1_definitions' or 'elementary5_fraction_definitions' (unitCodes, unitNames optional). 'paper_contracts' = form fields and functions of the paper search and TestPool pages (시험 검색 폼, 읽기 계약). Contract views need studentId (studentKey). Read only.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_get
tools.title: DailyRecord(수업일지) 조회
tools.description: DailyRecord (수업일지, 일지) reads; no LMS write. view 'record' (default): one student's live record of one date: fields[] (field, before.value, code label before.label; progress 진도, homework 숙제, lessonMemo 메모, attendance 출결, DT and homework assessments), assessmentCodeLabels, scope, authoringHandle. For every 일지 or 기록 조회 and a save's readback. displayName: the name as written. lessonDate: omit for today, else YYYY-MM-DD, 오늘, 어제, 11월 16일 or 11/16 (Asia/Seoul). fields: names to return (default all six). detail 'compact' drops authoringHandle. student_name_not_found: no record that date. 'intake': before-state of a scope with observationHandle and interviews; only when record gave authoringHandle null, or after stale_source. scope (from record) in context.scope or top-level (sourceNamespace, teacherId, studentId, lessonDate); context members (schemaVersion, purpose, currentRequestRef, selectedFields, memoAnswer, facts) may be top-level, given once (context_member_conflict); fields, suppliedValues. 'status': save attempts of scope (저장 실행 상태): per-field executions, requestRef, state, who; no LMS request; requestRef adds its audit. 'reconcile': reads the LMS once and classes each unresolved save of the record persisted, not_persisted or conflict (연결 끊김, 들어갔는지 확인); context as for review. To close one as not landed: resolution {request: {requestRef, instruction: {text: the user's words}}, executions: [{requestRef, field}] from 'status'}; not_persisted needs a new review and save. Writes: academy_dailyrecord_review.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_review
tools.title: DailyRecord 문안 검토
tools.description: Step 2 of a DailyRecord write (get, review, save, get): prepared with reviewDigest, or held with blockers; no write. Minimal call: {observationHandle: the string authoringHandle.observationHandle of academy_dailyrecord_get (60 minutes), proposals: [{field, value}]}. 메모/코멘트 = lessonMemo, 진도 = progress, 숙제 = homework. set or replace follows the current value. Code fields (attendance, dailyTestAssessment, previousHomeworkAssessment) only when the user asks for that field. Deadline line '- YYYY-MM-DD까지'. context.memoAnswer {kind: not_supplied, no_addition or content, text}: no_addition needs no requestRef; with a lessonMemo proposal it holds the row (no_addition_preserves_existing_memo). Show rows[].warnings to the user; if held, fix the blocker or ask.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_save
tools.title: DailyRecord 저장(LMS 쓰기)
tools.description: Step 3: writes the reviewed fields to the LMS DailyRecord and reads them back: status saved, or held with reasonCode. Only after academy_dailyrecord_review returned prepared and the user asked to save. Minimal call: {reviewDigest, instruction: the user's message verbatim}. context.memoAnswer {kind: no_addition} needs no requestRef. Then read back with academy_dailyrecord_get. stale_source or drift: get, review, save again. A held uncertain dispatch: no retry; see academy_dailyrecord_get view 'status'.

tools.name: academy_student_resolve
tools.title: 학생 키(studentKey) 확인
tools.description: Returns studentKey, the studentId of academy_paper_inspect, academy_runtime_inspect contract views and academy_dailytest_history (includeHeaders false); other tools take the name. Without lessonDate it searches recent records only; on student_name_not_found call once more with lessonDate = a date the student had a lesson (YYYY-MM-DD, 오늘, 어제, 11월 16일 or 11/16, Asia/Seoul), else ask the user for one. scope.studentId of academy_dailyrecord_get is the same key. Read only.

tools.name: academy_dailytest_history
tools.title: DailyTest(DT) 이력
tools.description: A student's DailyTest (DT) history: DT 이력, 시험 기록, 몇 개 쳤는지. periods: '11' = last month, '12' = 1-2 months ago … '16' = 5-6 months ago; all six for 전부. includeHeaders true (default): with paper titles, question counts (periods[].rows[].header.title, sourcePaperCount); needs studentName, periods; lessonDate: a date the student had a lesson (YYYY-MM-DD, 오늘, 어제, 11월 16일 or 11/16; default today); 32 papers per call; next: headerOffset = nextHeaderOffset, expectedSelectionSha256 = selectionSha256. native_dailyrecord_occurrence_unverified: no lesson that day; use includeHeaders false. includeHeaders false: DT 결과 목록, rows (paper key, attempt, score) per period; takes studentId (studentKey) or resolves studentName (studentResolution); without periods only the current filter (often empty). Read only.

tools.name: academy_paper_inspect
tools.title: 출력코드 시험지
tools.description: Printed papers (출력코드 #…). studentId: studentKey of academy_student_resolve. view: 'headers' = titles of up to 32 paperCodes, each with '#' (시험지 제목, 뭐였는지): observation.rows[].contentHeader.metadataRows, label 시험지 제목 = the title. 'definition' = one paperCode's 시험지 이름 and 문항 수: observation.information (title, questionCount, category, level); definitionView 'definition' (default) or 'header'; not whether the student took it. 'attempt' = whether and how the student took one paperCode in period {from, through} (YYYY-MM-DD): observation.status, observation.rows[] (sourceScore); not-found covers the searched page only. Read only.

tools.name: academy_textbook_section_results_get
tools.title: 교재 소단원 채점 결과(O/X)
tools.description: A student's textbook section results (교재 소단원, 필수예제, 유형다지기: score and O/X). Up to three calls, same displayName: 1) no bookLabel: with several books, interview_required, bindings[].bookLabel; 2) bookLabel = one of those labels or the user's book words as written (가우스 5-1-2, 다빈치 2권): index[].sourceTitle, courseKey, bookNo, bookSelection.boundLabel; words fitting several books or none give interview_required with candidate labels; 3) add sourceTitles = exact titles of that index: records[] with score and items[] (O/X, lectureKey). With book words start at 2; stop when answered. '가우스 5-1-2' is one book (grade 5, semester 1, volume 2: 초5-1 가우스 2권), not sections 5-1 or 5-2. Archived book: all of courseKey, bookNo, studentKey. Read only.

tools.name: academy_clinic_paper_status_get
tools.title: 오답·유사클리닉 대상
tools.description: Clinic candidates (오답클리닉, 유사클리닉): sections whose original attempt has wrong items, sections[].wrongItems[] (ordinal = item number, lectureKey). For 틀린 문항 and 오답 of a book or section. Steps as academy_textbook_section_results_get: no bookLabel gives bindings[].bookLabel; bookLabel (a label or the user's book words) gives sections[].sourceTitle and bookSelection; sourceTitles gives wrongItems. Clinic paper solving is not in the LMS: the teacher confirms it. Read only.

tools.name: academy_item_lookup
tools.title: 문항 번호 → 교재 섹션·정답
tools.description: Numeric item labels (문항 번호, lectureKey): the digits given or lectureKey of an earlier result (wrongItems, items, matches), max 32. include: 'section' = the original textbook section: items[].matches[] (sourceTitle, ordinal, O/X), ambiguousLabels; needs displayName; with several books pass bookLabel (a bindings[].bookLabel or the user's book words such as 가우스 5-1-2; bookSelection names it): scanning all books can time out. 'answer' = the official answer text, no student: answers[].answerLiteral '<prefix>|_|<answer>' with source unit and pattern names; quote the answer part, escape '|' in Markdown tables; view 'compact'. Both: {section, answer}. Read only.

tools.name: academy_textbook_catalog_get
tools.title: 교재 목차·카탈로그·PDF
tools.description: Textbooks. view: 'toc' first for a book's units, pages and chapter assessments (대단원 총괄평가), from kept data: no LMS request, no PDF; book: 가우스 5-1-2, 초5-1 가우스 2권, 가우스 5학년 1학기 2권 or the LMS bound-book label (no volume: every volume); unit: '6' or '6-5'; not_found lists names. 'catalog' = the LMS textbook and workbook PDF catalog (교재 카탈로그, 답지): entries[] (sourceLabels, kind sample/answer …, filename, documentRef); schoolLevel elementary 초등, middle 중등 (default), high 고등; query: book name words; documentKind; offset, limit. 'pdf' = one catalog PDF saved locally: sha256 and path, not text; documentRef, schoolLevel from catalog entries[]. Read only.

tools.name: academy_prestudy_get
tools.title: 예습영상·AI 리포트
tools.description: A student's prestudy videos (예습영상); displayName: the name as written. view (default 'videos'): 'videos' = waiting[] (uploaded, 검사 대기), completed[] (unitLabel, dateLiteral, prestudyKey) and summary[] (AI score literals: 예습 점수); 'incomplete' = waiting[] only; 'teacher_summary' = summary[] only. Empty summary: no AI score shown; say so, never derive one. includeReports true with reportId = a prestudyKey from completed[] or waiting[] (최근: the latest dateLiteral) gives that video's AI report: sections[] (title, text blocks), view.returnedSectionTitles; sectionTitles narrows it; maxOutputBytes. Without view only the report is read. One of includeReports, reportId without the other is refused. Read only.

tools.name: academy_cism_get
tools.title: 주간·월별 CISM
tools.description: CISM reads. scope: 'week' = the week (Sunday to Saturday) containing date: report.reportSha256, report.fields[] (fieldRef, label, kind, value, studentName); step 1 of a CISM write (get, review, save, get) and the readback after a save; date: YYYY-MM-DD, 오늘, 어제, 11월 16일 or 11/16 (Asia/Seoul), the answer states it. 'month' = every week touching month (YYYY-MM): reports[] (weekLabel, fields with values) and emptyFields, the empty field count (월별 CISM, 빈 칸 몇 개). Read only.

tools.name: academy_cism_weekly_review
tools.title: 주간 CISM 문안 검토
tools.description: Step 2 of a CISM write: checks proposed text against the current week and records the review: status reviewed, reviewDigest; no LMS write. date: as in the get. expectedReportSha256: report.reportSha256 of academy_cism_get scope 'week'. request: {requestRef: your id, instruction: the user's message verbatim}. changes[]: {fieldRef from report.fields[], before = its current value ('' if empty), after = new text from same-week DailyRecords or the user, evidenceRefs = the dated sources}. Only empty fields are filled unless edit is complete_existing_narrative. Never invent numbers.

tools.name: academy_cism_weekly_save
tools.title: 주간 CISM 저장(LMS 쓰기)
tools.description: Step 3: writes the reviewed CISM fields to the LMS, one request per change, read back: status persisted. Only after academy_cism_weekly_review returned reviewed. date, expectedReportSha256, request, changes: exactly as in that review; reviewDigest: from it. Then confirm with academy_cism_get scope 'week'. On a failure stop: never repeat the save for a field.

tools.name: academy_official_report_pdf_get
tools.title: 공식 리포트 PDF
tools.description: Official StudyQ PDF (공식·교재 리포트) by StudyQReport.exe on PC, read-only LMS. reportType course_book: displayName; courseKey+bookNo+studentKey or params.bookLabel. cism: params.scope week+date. diag/formative/ganga/na_score: displayName+params.testingNo+classNo. smart_book: displayName+params.bookCode. new_diag: params.paperNo+applyCode. Saved in owner root (no overwrite): outputPath, sha256, pages.

tools.name: academy_paper_print_pdf_get
tools.title: 시험지·클리닉지 인쇄 PDF
tools.description: Native print PDF (시험지·정답지·채점지) by StudyQPdfManager+ETestMaker on PC, read-only LMS. source paper: paperNo, printCase (default teacher_paper). result: testingNo+studentKey (score paper). Clinic papers: academy_clinic_paper_save printPdf. Saved in owner root (outputPath, -n per item): pdfs[] outputPath, sha256. pc_busy: retry later.

tools.name: academy_lms_schedule_get
tools.title: 출결·학습일정·과정관리
tools.description: Read-only LMS page. view: attendance (date or period, YYYY-MM-DD, ≤31 days, same month), study_schedule (gradeNo, groupKey, studentKey, courseKey), course_study_manager (gradeNo, semesterNo, levelNo, status), test_results (family da|fa|na: displayName, period ≤92 days; new_diag: sortDate): paperNo, testingNo, classNo, applyCode.

tools.name: academy_clinic_paper_review
tools.title: 오답·클리닉지 검토
tools.description: Read-only review of a wrong-note (book_incorrect) or clinic paper; clinic modes multiply/divide/custom. Answers change, reviewToken.

tools.name: academy_clinic_paper_save
tools.title: 오답·클리닉지 저장(LMS 쓰기)
tools.description: Creates the reviewed paper once, only after the teacher approves: reviewToken, userApproved true, the reviewed change. saved after readback, else unverified: no retry. printPdf true: also its PDFs on PC (pdf).

tools.name: academy_exam_paper_review
tools.title: 시험지 출제·배정 검토
tools.description: Read-only review of an FA (fa: sourcePaperNo or items {key,type obj|sbj|des}) or unit-exam (da: courseNo) paper for named students (targets {studentName,studentKey}, start/end YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). Answers change, preview, reviewToken.

tools.name: academy_exam_paper_save
tools.title: 시험지 출제·배정 저장(LMS 쓰기)
tools.description: Creates and assigns the reviewed exam once, only after the teacher approves: reviewToken, userApproved true, the reviewed change. saved after readback, else unverified: no retry.
